public_app_robots.about: What a public app's own robots.txt says when the app has not written one. Every engine may read the whole app unless its owner turned AI crawlers off (`allow_ai_crawlers` false on the installation); then the AI and answer-engine agents named in `without_ai_crawlers` are kept out and search engines still read it.

discovery.about: How an agent finds what this host offers from any page: the Link header set on every HTML page that has none, and the API catalog (RFC 9727) at api_catalog.path. A path is on this host.

markdown.about: Markdown on request (Accept: text/markdown) for the pages this service draws. A token is estimated as this share of a character.
